name: stream-machine
description: Hosted Twitch tools plus OBS and Stream Deck controls for your desktop.

interface.longDescription: Stream Machine Desktop installs three MCP servers on a desktop host. The hosted stream-machine server provides Twitch, clips, and the Stream Machine menu. The local stream-machine-obs server provides 7 OBS tools, and stream-machine-streamdeck provides 6 Stream Deck tools that lay out OBS scene, audio, record, and stream buttons on a USB deck. On web and mobile, install the Stream Machine Site plugin for Twitch instead.
defaultPrompt: Check OBS and my Stream Deck, then connect Twitch through the stream-machine server.
